Each is v1.01's C with that release's constants and offsets: 50 Hz timing (30 to 25, 60 to 50, 60.0f to 50.0f), text ids, moved fields and callees. When the v1.01 file has other flags, the C goes in a sibling file with the same flags (-g8 or a cflags line). No C in src/ changes.
Three PAL functions are left as assembly. They build to their own bytes, but they refer to v1.01 names that are other places in PAL…
